name: Niederzier (Germany)
description: Square banner of the municipal arms of Niederzier: yellow with a black lion in the upper part and black vertical stripes in the lower part.
history: Municipal flag of Niederzier; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: black stripes in the lower part
